description:
Billionaires are turning NFL stadiums into gated communities, catering to the ultra-rich.

We talked to lifelong Cleveland Browns fans priced out of their new stadium.

To get tickets, fans need to buy Personal Seat Licenses, which could cost $500 to $200,000 per seat.

Host: Dan Moore

author: More Perfect Union
description:
Student loan lenders are having an amazing year.

While Americans drown in $2 trillion of student loan debt, private lenders are charging up to 18% interest on their loans and making hundreds of thousands of dollars on just one loan.

Sallie Mae and SoFi are reporting record numbers right now, as borrowers suffer.

Producer/Host: @lucydeanstockton.online
Editor: @discosludge
Research: @kmoslade
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: Student Loans are Crushing Americans with $400,000 in Debt — While Lenders Party
